about:
Skippy Foods operates from Little Rock, Arkansas, where it has produced peanut butter since 1933. The brand, recognized by its distinctive teal jar, began as a simple peanut butter spread and grew into a globally recognized consumer icon. No founders or ownership structure are disclosed in the available information.

The company manufactures a line of peanut butter products that includes creamy peanut butter, natural peanut butter spreads, P.B. Bites, squeeze packs, and a squeeze Greek yogurt snack cup. The product range reflects a focus on convenient formats, though the input does not detail manufacturing processes, facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

Skippy serves the consumer packaged goods market, targeting peanut butter enthusiasts worldwide. The brand positions itself as a household staple rather than a business-to-business supplier, and no specific industrial customers or sectors are identified.

The company cites its 80-year heritage and the emotional connection consumers have with its products as key differentiators, framing peanut butter as a way of life rather than merely a spread.
